entries.issuing_body: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (Division of Market Oversight)
entries.title: CFTC staff advisory warns designated contract markets against broad, template-style self-certifications of event contract series
entries.facts: On July 24, 2026, the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission's Division of Market Oversight (DMO) issued an advisory reminding designated contract markets (DCMs) about the proper procedures for submitting self-certifications of an event contract series. The advisory addresses concerns about the practice of submitting broad, template-style certifications that combine many potential event contract variations into a single certification. According to the advisory, this approach limits DMO's ability to determine whether a DCM has provided all the information, explanation, and analysis required by Commission Regulation Section 40.2, and whether it has adequately evaluated the settlement methodology, data sources, and core-principles compliance of any contract it intends to list. The guidance reiterates that broad, template-style certifications should not be submitted, and explains when closely related event contracts may be certified as a class or submitted for approval under Commission Regulations Sections 40.2(d) or 40.3. The advisory was issued as CFTC Staff Letter No. 26-22.
entries.source_label: CFTC Press Release 9273-26 (Division of Market Oversight advisory; CFTC Staff Letter No. 26-22) — July 24, 2026
entries.relevant_to: prediction-market operators and other designated contract markets that list event contracts, and their compliance/listing teams — self-certification submissions must provide full per-contract Reg 40.2 analysis rather than broad template-style filings

entries.issuing_body: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (Division of Market Oversight)
entries.title: CFTC staff issues time-limited no-action position to Kraken Derivatives Exchange Inc. on designated contract market dormancy procedures
entries.facts: On July 24, 2026, the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission's Division of Market Oversight announced it had issued a no-action letter to Kraken Derivatives Exchange Inc., formerly Small Exchange Inc., a designated contract market, addressing certain procedures related to dormancy. The Division stated the no-action position is time-limited and subject to the terms and conditions in the no-action letter. The position was issued in response to a request from Kraken Derivatives Exchange Inc. to extend the no-action position previously granted to the exchange in CFTC Letter No. 25-46. The no-action position was issued as CFTC Staff Letter No. 26-21.
entries.source_label: CFTC Press Release 9272-26 (Division of Market Oversight no-action position; CFTC Staff Letter No. 26-21) — July 24, 2026
entries.relevant_to: designated contract markets and crypto-derivatives venues tracking CFTC staff no-action practice on DCM operational procedures
